turnos.t: Evaluate, discuss, examine, recommend. What do they have in common?

They're assessment objective three, usually ten marks. All of them want you to weigh arguments and reach a judgement. Evaluate weighs strengths and limitations. Discuss gives a balanced review with a supported conclusion. Examine uncovers the hidden assumptions behind an argument.
Advise one course of action. 'To what extent' states how far you agree. Listing pros and cons is not enough: say which matters more, for whom, and why.
